consequence.statement: Bumping the markdown package used only by the /hack/api-docs documentation tooling has no operational effect on deployed external-secrets installations.

assertion.statement: The external-secrets repository bumped its /hack/api-docs documentation-tooling dependency markdown from 3.7 to 3.8.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The bump is scoped to repository build tooling under /hack/api-docs; no customer-environment input (Helm values, manifests, workloads, cluster state) carries this documentation dependency, so no exposure condition can be expressed.
